# Wazuh 5 adapter - gaps and assumptions (GENERATED by tools/render.py from tuning/intents/ - do not edit; change the intent and run `make render`.)

Experimental: written against the official 4.x->5.x rules migration guide for 5.0.0-rc2. Not engine-verified - the 5.x Suricata integration ships through Wazuh CTI at runtime, and rules are evaluated by the indexer, so there is no offline logtest. Evidence: `static` + the rule model in tests/unit/test_render.py (same cases as the 4.x logtest files).

## Assumptions to confirm with content-manager logtest

- Signature id in `rule.id`; addresses and ports in `source.ip`, `destination.ip`, `source.port`, `destination.port`, `network.transport` (`network.transport` lower-case).
- `logsource.product: suricata` is the title of the integration the rules belong to.
- Analyst-visible threshold: findings at `low` or above (4.x level 6, mapped with the guide's table).

## Generic severity rules must skip the tuned SIDs

Rules no longer chain, so a generic Suricata severity rule still matches a lowered event. Add this filter to those rules; the per-SID rules in `rules/` take over:

```yaml
filter_tuned_sids:
  rule.id: [2025701]
# condition: <existing> and not filter_tuned_sids
```

## Not expressible in 5.0

- `smb-exe-domain-controllers`: `ignore` 3600 s (ENRICH rate limit) - no correlation or suppression in the 5.0 rule format; every event becomes a finding. Option: an Alerting monitor over the findings index.
